description.en: The DSH bundle for dsh-remedy: a patch set that repairs fused tool-call JSON at the stream seam and names the refusals it will not retry. This index points at the published npm artifact; the same code is also on GitHub as dsh-remedy.
description.zh: dsh-remedy 的 DSH 插件包：在流接缝上修复粘连的工具调用 JSON，并命名它拒绝重试的那些失败类。此索引指向已发布的 npm 产物；同一份代码也在 GitHub 上。

description.en: Repairs fused tool-call arguments at the llm/stream seam and re-throws whatever it cannot prove, names the deterministic refusals it will not retry at agent/request-error, and answers per failure class which patch covers it and whether that patch is switched on here.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 接缝上修复粘连的工具调用参数，证不出来的原样抛回；在 agent/request-error 上命名它不重试的确定性拒绝；并按失败类回答哪个补丁覆盖它、以及它在本 profile 里是否启用。

head.en: The repository carries twenty-six patches and every one of them is inside the published 0.4.3 artifact. That artifact is the first one measured on DSH 0.2.2-rc.3, the desktop build released 2026-11-13; the supported range is unchanged, so this index still pins the npm bytes rather than a commit.
head.zh: 仓库有二十六个补丁，而且全部都在已发布的 0.4.3 产物里。这份产物是第一个在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3（2026-11-13 发布的桌面版）上实测过的版本；适配范围未变，所以本索引仍钉 npm 字节而不是某个提交。
